strongest_angle: Break down how Martha Nussbaum won the Library of Congress's 2026 John W. Kluge Prize for her lifelong philosophical work on human capabilities and emotions.

key_facts.fact: The Library of Congress announced on September 22, 2026, that Professor Martha C. Nussbaum is the recipient of the John W. Kluge Prize for Achievement in the Study of Humanity.
The John W. Kluge Prize is awarded every other year by the Library of Congress to recognize work that advances understanding of the human experience.
Martha C. Nussbaum defended a neo-Stoic account of emotions holding that they are appraisals ascribing great significance to things and persons outside the agent's control.
